title: They are PLASTIC warmth 3x longer than ceramic cups
text: They are PLASTIC warmth 3x longer than ceramic cups. They are PLASTIC.. (instead of saying tritan as material, how bout adding (plastic) so I dont feel lied to).  Warmth is great. But I still feel lied to over the plastic or tritan material.  That's why 3 star.

product_metadata.title: Carlisle FoodService Products 4306814 Break-Resistant Tritan Coffee Mug, 12 oz, Ocean Blue (Pack of 12)
features: Made of high-strength, break-resistant Tritan plastic
Large handles keep fingers away from hot liquids
Safe for temperatures up to 190 degrees F
description: The Carlisle 4306814 mug is a restaurant quality 12 ounce coffee cup perfect for serving a variety of hot beverages. Made from high-strength, break-resistant Tritan plastic, this mug is designed to stand up to the demands of a commercial food service environment yet is not out of place around the home or office.
The mugs feature a specially designed large handle that allows for easy holding and keeps fingers away from hot liquids. The mugs are safe for temperatures up to 190 degrees F.
The Carlisle 4306814 12 ounce plastic mug is dishwasher safe and certified by the National Sanitation Foundation (NSF).
